title: Patrick Arena

terrainReference.basis: Independent modern terrain height at the estimated outer entrance line on the Cadboro Bay Road side.

mapIdentity.provider: Oak Bay Archives historic address and recorded rink dimensions registered to original OpenStreetMap street axes.
mapIdentity.scope: Oak Bay Archives fixes the 144 ft 2 in by 322 ft 2 in rink dimensions and the historic address east of Epworth Street. The modern road survey constrains placement and orientation. Setbacks are estimates.

note: The January 1912 Dwyer photograph fixes the curved roof, corner towers, storefront entrance, tall paired and stepped window panels, and ARENA lettering. The contemporary construction report identifies the timber truss roof.
